en: Color-tinted postcard showing a riverside landscape with steep cliffs and a castle complex on the left hill, another ruined castle with two towers on a hill in the center-right, and the river Saale flowing through a wooded valley. On the right side of the card there is a short poem printed in red Gothic-style script. At the bottom, in red text, are the caption identifying the view and the publisher details.
